summary: Call add_languages('objc') where the cocoa/audiounit features are enabled, not only where a macOS SDK is detected.
markersNote: A meson-level build fix with no runtime footprint: it only makes add_languages('objc') run, without which ao_audiounit.m is never compiled. Its effect is asserted by the audio-output category — if this patch had not applied, the audiounit AO would be missing entirely.
